scopeReview: CED Topic 1.4 LIM-1.C: numerical estimates from explicit tables, side direction, scale/rounding limitations, and distinguishing point values from nearby behavior. varietyReview: Eleven original paired tables cover two-sided/one-sided estimates, conflicting sides, missing values, isolated assignments, formula-backed unbounded growth, rounded data limitations, a multistep transformed quotient, contextual units and unjustified distant extrapolation. Eight programmatic numerical table checks plus three separately reasoned limitations/formula items.
repetitionReview: Each prompt and all four options were read separately; distinct tasks/contexts within this set. Cross-topic exact duplicates checked by validator. Semantic similarity and AP difficulty remain judgment calls, not proven by an automated score.
